comment: Suite registry for scripts/verify.sh (TASK-2). Status is ACTIVE (the entry point runs it now) or PENDING (the owning task has not built it yet). Only the owning task flips PENDING to ACTIVE, by editing this file. A PENDING suite is never run, is never printed as passed, and is not evidence of parity or compatibility.

suites.name: build
suites.description: mvn verify on JDK 17+ with production compilation at --release 11 (DEC-3)

suites.name: dependency-policy
suites.description: maven-enforcer bans Kotlin, kotlinx and Kotlin-backed okio artifacts from production scope including transitives; test and build tooling exempt (DEC-4)

suites.name: bytecode-java11
suites.description: module jars and production dependency jars expose only class files Java 11 can select (major <= 55, multi-release aware); the production dependency set (javapoet for the generator, none for runtime and schema) is scanned and reported

suites.name: runtime-tests
suites.description: applicable upstream wire-runtime test cases with tracked adaptations (DEC-5); key is the wire-runtime-java module total inside mvn verify (adapted plus port-only cases); TASK-14 owns per-case reconciliation

suites.name: schema-tests
suites.description: applicable upstream wire-schema test cases with tracked adaptations (DEC-5); key is the wire-schema-java module total inside mvn verify (adapted plus port-only cases); per-case ledger docs/task13-case-accounting.md, reconciliation TASK-14

suites.name: parity-coverage
suites.description: pinned upstream tag provenance verified and every in-scope upstream test file reconciled against port artifacts (config/upstream-case-map.json); unaccounted files, lost cases, missing reasons, unrecorded skips (every @Disabled/@Ignore needs a mirrored upstream ignore or a recorded disposition), false fixture classifications, and (post-build) executed-case identities all fail the run

suites.name: protoc-oracle
suites.description: protoc 4.36.1 interoperability oracle: pinned protoc reference models and pinned upstream wire-compiler fixtures in the never-published wire-protoc-compat-java module; key is that module total inside mvn verify (per-case skip dispositions, 48 recorded DEC-6 fixture exclusions and 1 mirrored upstream ignore (boxOneOfsJava), are in config/upstream-case-map.json; the module total moves with new port-only cases), ledger in the module test sources

suites.name: compiler-tests
suites.description: Java generator and compiler behavior: wire-java-generator cases inside mvn verify (31 disabled, all recorded DEC-6 Kotlin-generator exclusions; the two ProtoTarget cases were revived by TASK-16.2; per-case dispositions in config/upstream-case-map.json; the module total moves with new port-only cases); ledger docs/task16-case-accounting.md; interim module-total key, per-case reconciliation via parity-coverage

suites.name: security-corpus
suites.description: security regression corpus as permanent tests: the three SecurityCorpusTest classes run inside mvn verify; registry and per-item pinned-source evidence in docs/security-regression-inventory.md

suites.name: java11-consumer
suites.description: consumer main compiled and run on an actual Java 11 JVM against the module jars, exercising ProtoWriter and the loading layer; TASK-21 carries the published-artifact check (DEC-3)

suites.name: duplicate-class-check
suites.description: class-origin report plus duplicate detection for com.squareup.wire and retained okio names on every module test classpath (compatibility matrix section G)

suites.name: upstream-watch
suites.description: informational upstream tag watch: scripts/check-upstream.sh compares the newest square/wire tag from git ls-remote with the pin in config/parity-pins.json and checks the pinned tag object still matches the remote. PASS means the watch RAN AND REPORTED; the note carries state=CURRENT/BEHIND/PIN_MOVED, so an upstream release never fails the run, and only a watch that could not run (network, malformed pins) records NOT_RUN and fails. The weekly GitHub-advisories page review is the owned manual checklist in docs/upstream-sync.md (advisories need auth, so detection is tag-based plus manual)
